topics.title_zh: Meta俄亥俄吉瓦集群曝光：百万GPU规模与电力基建引爆全栈竞赛
topics.title_en: Meta Unveils Prometheus: Gigawatt Supercluster with 1M GPUs Ignites Infrastructure War
topics.summary_zh: Meta官方披露位于俄亥俄州的吉瓦级AI超级集群Prometheus，全面扩容后将容纳约100万块显卡并已支撑Muse基座模型训练。此举引发了行业对全栈云基础设施与能源垄断的大讨论，资本狂热与算力落地的矛盾再度升级。
topics.summary_en: Meta revealed details of Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale supercluster in Ohio designed to host ~1M GPUs at full scale, powering its Muse foundational models. The announcement intensified debates over power grids, energy-to-compute integration, and runaway capital intensity in frontier AI training.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 前沿算力架构师与基础设施投行
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Frontier compute architects and infrastructure investors
perspective_pro.point_zh: 前沿基础模型突破必须依赖吉瓦级供电与百万卡并行网络，整合电力与云算力的垂直重资产是迈向超人类智能的唯一物理路径。
perspective_pro.point_en: Scaling to superhuman intelligence demands gigawatt-scale power and million-GPU fabrics; integrating energy with full-stack compute is an inescapable physical imperative.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 资本泡沫与能耗审慎派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 硅谷理性投资人与宏观行业分析师
perspective_con.speaker_en: Silicon Valley rationalists and macro analysts
perspective_con.point_zh: 百亿美元沉淀于重资产电力基建是对资本的极度挥霍，模型架构若迎来参数精简革命，巨额折旧与电网承载力将迅速沦为沉没成本。
perspective_con.point_en: Sinking tens of billions into massive power grids represents irrational capital bloat; algorithmic efficiency breakthroughs could turn these depreciating clusters into massive stranded assets.

topics.category_tag_zh: 智能体安全与攻防边界
topics.title_zh: 黑客花5000美元驱役Agent破百企，微软紧急将AI列为内鬼防范
topics.title_en: Hackers Spend $5K on AI Agents to Breach 100+ Firms; Microsoft Classifies Agents as Insider Threats
topics.summary_zh: 安全监测显示攻击者仅耗资约5000美元便利用自主AI智能体渗透约翰迪尔等上百家跨国实体网络。与此同步，智能体大流量遭主流网站封锁，微软紧急在365 E7及Perception系统中把智能体定义为潜在“内鬼威胁”展开严审。
topics.summary_en: Reports revealed a hacker spent just ~$5,000 using AI agent armies to target 1,200+ websites and breach over 100 entities including John Deere. In response, web portals are actively blocking autonomous traffic, and Microsoft introduced tools in its 365 E7 suite treating AI agents as potential insider threats.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 自动化极客与下一代Agent开发者
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Automation developers and next-gen agent builders
perspective_pro.point_zh: 自主智能体打破了传统自动化瓶颈，极低成本完成复杂长链条交互，过度拦截与过度防御会彻底锁死AI重构数字生产力的大门。
perspective_pro.point_en: Autonomous agents shatter legacy automation constraints at negligible cost; overly defensive lockouts risk suffocating the next leap in enterprise and digital productivity.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 企业首席信息安全官与合规监管层
perspective_con.speaker_en: Enterprise CISOs and regulatory compliance directors
perspective_con.point_zh: 具备自主调用权限的Agent本质就是高危未受控终端，攻击门槛断崖式下跌，必须强制推行零信任沙盒并严控其客户数据访问权限。
perspective_con.point_en: Unconstrained agents wielding system execution rights are dangerous attack vectors; plunging breach costs mandate zero-trust isolation and rigorous enterprise compliance.

topics.title_zh: DeepSeek联手华为研发昇腾950DT，美土安局同天下令联邦全面围堵
topics.title_en: DeepSeek Partners with Huawei on Ascend 950DT as US DHS Bans Technology Across Agencies
topics.summary_zh: 外媒披露DeepSeek正与华为联合定制未来AI芯片，并计划2026年底采用昇腾950DT开展模型预训练。同一时间，美国土安全部下令所有联邦民事机构全面剔除DeepSeek技术并禁止未来采购，地缘政治与软硬件协同战火急剧升级。
topics.summary_en: The Information reported that DeepSeek is collaborating with Huawei on future chip designs, planning to utilize the Ascend 950DT for pre-training by late 2026. Concurrently, the US DHS ordered all federal civilian agencies to purge DeepSeek tech and barred future procurement, highlighting an escalating tech divide.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 本土芯片架构师与算法自研团队
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Domestic silicon architects and DeepSeek core contributors
perspective_pro.point_zh: 顶级算法团队深度介入底层架构设计，能从DSA指令与通信层面突破算力制裁瓶颈，打造真正脱离英伟达生态的独立闭环。
perspective_pro.point_en: Direct algorithmic involvement in silicon design optimizes bespoke architectures, paving the way to bypass foreign GPU monopolies with resilient full-stack co-design.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 地缘脱钩与生态悲观派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 全球化供应链观察员与跨国合规法律顾问
perspective_con.speaker_en: Supply chain strategists and international compliance counsels
perspective_con.point_zh: 软硬件协同难以在短期内弥补先进制程与CUDA生态的巨大鸿沟，且叠加欧美政府合规禁令，将加速引发其全球商业化扩张的硬着陆。
perspective_con.point_en: Custom silicon cannot quickly offset advanced node constraints and mature CUDA moats, while sweeping federal blacklists will choke off international enterprise adoption.

linked_news.title_en: Sources: DeepSeek and Huawei are collaborating on future AI chip designs; DeepSeek plans to start using Ascend 950DT for pre-training as soon as 2026's end (The Information)
